3. Stimulation Group Responses

Script: analysis_scripts/plot_stim_group_responses.py

Simple stimulation response grouping analysis.

3.1. Channel Classification

Post-stimulation response type:

  • unchanged

  • post_increase

  • post_decrease

  • mixed_post

During-stimulation response type:

  • during_increase

  • no_during_increase

3.2. Comparison Modes

pre

Stim post/during compared to stim pre-stim baseline.

control

Stim post/during compared to matched control trials.

3.3. Figures Generated

  • Changed vs. unchanged PSTH.

  • Response type PSTH.

  • During increase vs. no-during-increase PSTH.

  • Class count bar plot.

  • Utah grid class map.
